messages.author: 3c9f490182e3833b
messages.subject: importing categorical data into landmark data frame
parts:
Hello all, 

Apologies in advance if my question is a bit elementary for this group... but I am in need of some guidance. 

I have generated 3D landmark data for 17 fossil specimens in 3DSlicer (saved as mrk.json files) and I am trying to import it along with associated categorical data. I am eager to perform a procrustes ANOVA (or a CVA in the MASS package), but I am stumped as to how to correctly incorporate categorical data (i.e., "morphological stage") that is associated with each specimen. I have tried reading in a simple table with the specimen and morpho stage but I have been unsuccessful in incorporating it into an array or data frame. Below is some of the code I have been working with:

#directory where all my mrk.json files are stored
files=dir(patt='json')

fixed.LMs = 1:7
semi.LMs = 8:283
samples = gsub(".mrk.json", '', fixed=T, files) #these are my fossil specimen IDs

LMs = array(dim=c(283, 3, 17))

for (i in 1:17) LMs[,,i] = read.markups.json(files[i])
dimnames(LMs) = list(paste0("LM_",1:283), c("x", "y", "z"), samples)

gpa = gpagen(A=LMs, surfaces = semi.LMs, ProcD = TRUE)
pca = gm.prcomp(gpa$coords)

The GPA and PCA ran successfully. Do I need to somehow incorporate the morpho_stage data into the LM object? Or can I perform procD.lm with my categorical data saved as another R object? 

Many thanks in advance, 
Kat

messages.author: baf6eb7bae06984d
messages.subject: Re: importing categorical data into landmark data frame
parts:
Kat,

Look at the geomorph.data.frame function help in geomorph. That's what you will need to use.

so if your morphological stages are exactly int the same order as your coordinate data in a variable called stages

you can create the geomorph data frame with something like:

gdf = geomorph.data.frame(Coords=gpa$Coords, Stages=stages)

then you can include Stages in your procrustes anova via:

proc.aov = anova(procD.lm(Coords~Stages, data=gdf))

For more specifics look at the geomorph vignette (https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/geomorph/geomorph.pdf)

messages.author: 333f3e76f253995a
messages.subject: Re: [geomorph-r-package] importing categorical data into landmark data frame
parts:
Hi Kathleen,  recommend using geomorph.data.frame as follows:

mydata <- geomorph.data.frame(Y=gpa$coords, morphological_stage=myCategoricalData)

This way, you can call procD.lm directly:

 procD.lm(Y ~ morphological_stage, data=mydata)

Kind regards,

Ale
